desc:
⚠️ THE ORIGINAL GAME IS BACK!
🌟 Will you be born as a weak slime? or a strong ogre! 🌟
Reincarnate, evolve, and become ridiculously powerful in this anime-inspired incremental RPG.


🧬 EVOLVE YOUR RACE & SKILLS
Consume enemies to absorb their abilities! Progress through an expansive evolutionary tree—from a simple Slime to a mighty Demon Lord. Unlock, upgrade, and combine hundreds of unique skills and resistances to create the perfect build.

⚔️ CONQUER THE DUNGEON
Step into the boundless Dungeon

✨ Collect Traits, Spirits & Subordinates

💎 Hunt Rare Boss Relics

♻️ Prestige and grow even stronger
